assertions.assertion: Explains that a new public key must be published (available via JWKS as a validation key) BEFORE it is used to sign tokens
assertions.rationale: States 'Publish a new public key before you sign with it' and Phase 1 adds the new key via AddValidationKey before signing.

assertions.assertion: Explains that the retired public key must remain available until all tokens signed with it have expired
assertions.rationale: Rule says keep retired public key until every token signed with it expired; Phase 2 keeps old key via AddValidationKey for the max token lifetime.

assertions.assertion: Describes a phased/multi-step rotation using AddSigningCredential and AddValidationKey (or equivalent) rather than a single hard cut-over
assertions.rationale: Three-phase rotation with AddSigningCredential and AddValidationKey code, explicitly rejecting single-deployment swap.

assertions.assertion: Notes that Automatic Key Management handles this overlap automatically while manual key managers must do phased rotation
assertions.rationale: Recommendation section says Automatic Key Management does the announce/activate/retire cycle for you, contrasting with manual phases.
